title: Chat message request
description: `{ text?, notes?, cards?, files? }`: the person's message, with the notes (by `seq`) and cards (by number) attached to it as chips and the files attached to it by path. `text` is left out to send only what is attached and the board's new answers.

text.description: What the person wrote; left out when they wrote nothing.

notes.description: The person's notes sent with the message, by the `seq` that made each; left out when none.

items.description: A card, by its number on the session's board.

cards.description: The cards sent with the message, by number; left out when none.

items.description: A path `attach_chat_file` answered, relative to the folder.

files.description: The files attached to the message, by the path `attach_chat_file` answered; left out when none.
